description: Formal IMDB 10-seed training and validation-selected test evaluation for five parameter-matched models, migrated from Amarel to two serial SJC GPU lanes.
notes: The prior Amarel preflight 61717068 completed; array 61717069 task 0 was cancelled after 52 seconds and tasks 1-49 never started. The Amarel campaign remains cancelled with 0/50 valid units.
The SJC campaign preserves the canonical five-model task map: LSTM H128, RNN H304, GRU H155, GaWF H171, and GaWF-logits H301; seeds 1-10; one layer; 50 epochs; no Mamba or S5.
GPU 0 runs even task IDs serially and GPU 1 runs odd task IDs serially. The runner validates each unit with experiments/text/imdb_5model_best10seed.py before writing its done marker.
The 11 processed IMDB files total 161250922 bytes and were verified by per-file SHA256 before promotion to the SJC data path.

A first wrapper attempt exited before the launcher because the outer Conda activation saw an unset MKL_INTERFACE_LAYER; it created no result or status artifacts. The active direct tmux launch uses the corrected commit.
